decision: We will record mensagem_enviada via an AFTER INSERT trigger on cs_chat_mensagens (+ backfill) and count the daily chat caps from cs_fluxo_eventos.
options_considered: Python insert after _gravar_mensagem (2 calls, not 1 txn); RPC for message insert (changes write path); trigger = same INSERT for every writer incl. N-1. Migration pre-sanctioned by the coordinator brief (D, EOA).

decision: We will CREATE OR REPLACE cs_chat_proposta_salvar_roteiro (same signature) to write estrutura_ids from cs_chat_proposta_estruturas (ordem), and backfill empty rows.
options_considered: Pass the ids in from Python (RPC has no parameter for it -> would need a new overload); derive inside the RPC from the links it already reads for usos (one source).

decision: We will add a markdown-image class to detectar_proibido, move the single-headline guard into saida_ia (one derivation) and count refused headlines as new event headline_invalida.
options_considered: Reuse roteiro_invalido for headlines (mixes two metrics); count unsafe-headline separately -> headline_invalida (CHECK widened in 370).

decision: We will store reels beat labels as plain (Beat), ask the model for plain (Beat), and make the teleprompter drop a standalone or leading (Label).
options_considered: Keep bold (teleprompter already drops bold-only lines but not an inline **(CTA)** fala); plain label + teleprompter rule covers both shapes.
